character: A very large man in his forties, broad and heavy through the chest and arms, head shaved, a short dark beard grey at the chin. A flat, patient expression, heavy-lidded eyes. Thick scarred knuckles, a small old scar through one eyebrow
wardrobe: a rough undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a long heavy leather apron stained dark, a bar cloth over one shoulder, dark trousers and plain boots

full.framing: Full body standing portrait, front view, arms folded, plain neutral background.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, looking straight at the viewer, expression unreadable.

scene.framing: A huge barkeeper behind a rough plank bar, wiping a tankard with a cloth, raw timber and iron bolts of a bridge's underside close overhead, crude shelves of bottles, a single swaying oil lamp, drinkers in shadow along the bar.
